questions.question: What question does Jeremiah put to God in chapter 12?
options: Who am I that you should send me?
When will this exile finally end?
Why does the way of the wicked prosper?
Where can I go to hide from your presence?
questions.answer: Why does the way of the wicked prosper?

questions.question: How does God answer Jeremiah's complaint?
options: By telling him simply to stop all prophesying and to rest himself awhile
By promising him to remove every one of his troubles all at once
By asking how he will compete with horses if he is worn out racing men
By sending down a mighty angel to fight all of his battles for him
questions.answer: By asking how he will compete with horses if he is worn out racing men
